question: Which bar type should be used for the asset in `state`?

options.temporal: use a fixed-time bar; the series behaves evenly in time
options.dollar_bars: sample by traded value; volume is uneven in time
options.volume_bars: sample by volume; trade intensity is the driver
options.range_bars: sample by price movement; quiet periods are uninformative
options.tick_bars: sample by transaction count on the raw tick stream

samples.state: Sampling evenly in clock time loses nothing because activity is uniform through the session.
samples.label: temporal
samples.option_text: use a fixed-time bar; the series behaves evenly in time

samples.state: Trade sizes vary by two orders of magnitude across the day, so equal-time bars carry wildly unequal value.
samples.label: dollar_bars
samples.option_text: sample by traded value; volume is uneven in time

samples.state: Activity clusters hard around the open and close, and the intent is to sample by traded quantity.
samples.label: volume_bars
samples.option_text: sample by volume; trade intensity is the driver

samples.state: Long stretches of the session have almost no price movement, so time bars waste most of their rows.
samples.label: range_bars
samples.option_text: sample by price movement; quiet periods are uninformative

samples.state: The raw tick stream is available and the intent is to sample by number of transactions.
samples.label: tick_bars
samples.option_text: sample by transaction count on the raw tick stream

samples.state: The series is an equity index future with a strong intraday activity cycle and a dollar-value objective.
samples.label: dollar_bars
samples.option_text: sample by traded value; volume is uneven in time

samples.state: Each bar should hold a comparable amount of price travel rather than a comparable amount of time.
samples.label: range_bars
samples.option_text: sample by price movement; quiet periods are uninformative

samples.state: Every session shows the same activity profile and the series behaves evenly in time.
samples.label: temporal
samples.option_text: use a fixed-time bar; the series behaves evenly in time
